thesis: This episode argues that Andy Feldman sold ODFL and significantly trimmed his INTU position because management at both companies lost their reinvestment theses by spending excessive shareholder capital on high-multiple acquisitions. Specifically, ODFL is criticized for buying two acquisitions at extremely high multiples after stopping organic reinvestment, while Intuit is viewed as a risk because management continues to blow money on questionable deals like Mail.com and Credit Karma despite having a great core business.
